title: Managing Self and Leading Others
overview: This program is tailored for supervisors, managers, and individuals at any organizational level seeking to enhance their leadership skills. It is ideal for those keen on self-discovery and self-reflection, aiming to understand themselves better and leverage their influencing abilities for effective management and leadership. The course guides participants through a journey of personal development, imparting strategies and skills that contribute to success both professionally and personally
audience: This course caters to both new and seasoned supervisors and managers across various organizational functions. It is equally beneficial for individuals aspiring to enhance their self-awareness, management skills, and leadership abilities. Additionally, the course is well-suited for those seeking a refresher, a fresh perspective, or inspiration on the subject matter
methodology: This course employs self-assessment tools to analyze and uncover participants' proficiency in managing and leading others. The learning experience incorporates group presentations, discussions, role-playing exercises, and case analyses for a comprehensive and interactive approach
competencies: Collaborating effectively with colleagues, supervisors, subordinates, and other stakeholders
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify strengths and areas of improvement in oneself and others
Strategize and set goals aligned with values and aspirations
Build trust and achieve results through leadership coaching
Influence others effectively, even without formal authority
Lead with a focus on long-term results

items.text: Questionnaires for self-awareness, including emotional intelligence, interpersonal needs (FIRO-B), assertiveness, the 'big five locator,' cognitive style, etc.
